messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Severity: P2 - GPU allocation errors in gcp-ap-southeast4. Autoscaler failing to stabilize; queue depth rising > 2k. @ryan_oncall please acknowledge :rotating_light:
ryan_oncall: acked. looking now. seeing spikes in pending-alloc metric and repeated quotaExceeded errors in cloud logs.
lina_sre: confirmed. stackdriver shows repeated responses from gcp: 
```
  {"error": "quotaExceeded", "reason": "PER_PROJECT_GPU_LIMIT", "details": "requested 8, available 0"}
```
traffic started oscillating after warm-pool eviction triggered scale-up/backoff loop.
amy_ops: customer-impact note: some customers see 502/503 and inference latency >8s on GPU routes; non-GPU routes ok. CS flagged a large customer (AcmeCorp) with degraded SLAs.
jai_infra: quick summary from infra: project-level soft quota reached (ap-southeast4), autoscaler requested nodes but GCP returned 403 quota deny; internal reclaim loop then scaled down warm nodes -> queue grew -> autoscaler retried -> denied -> rinse.
ryan_oncall: steps: 1) add runbook link 2) attempt manual reroute to us-west2 3) reduce GPU traffic by switching traffic splitter to CPU-safe variant for low-priority routes.
maria_prod: runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-oscillation. follow sections B & D.
ben_custsuccess: I'll message AcmeCorp with a brief and ETA. keeping them informed reduces churn.
lina_sre: attempting short mitigations now:
- disabling autoscaler for pool `gpu-warm-pool-apse4` (to stop churn)
- deleting idle warm pods reclaimed by kube: `kubectl delete pod -l role=warm --namespace=inference --field-selector=status.phase=Succeeded`
- toggling routing policy to prefer us-west2 for new requests:
```
POST /admin/route-split
{ "routes": [ {"region":"us-west2","weight":70}, {"region":"ap-southeast4","weight":30} ] }
```
ryan_oncall: doing toggle now. if routing succeeds, we should see pending-alloc drop and tail latency improve within 2-3 minutes.
amy_ops: running quota increase request in parallel: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod` then `gcloud compute quotas request-increase --project=redwood-prod --region=ap-southeast4 --metric=GPUS --amount=200` (request submitted). Ticket #GPQ-8123.
jai_infra: note: quota increases can take hours and sometimes require sales justification. plan B: temporarily redirect heavy customers to Dedicated pools in us-west2 and apply cached responses for low-priority workloads.
maria_prod: monitoring dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/obs?panel=gpu_pending&region=ap-southeast4. seeing pending-alloc fall as routing change propagates.
ben_custsuccess: AcmeCorp updated: "we see partial recovery; thanks for the quick update". they asked for ETA on full recovery.
lina_sre: current status: 1) autoscaler disabled on pool (manual override) 2) routing shifted 70/30 to us-west2 3) quota increase requested 4) manual pod reclamation executed 5) CS notified customers.
ryan_oncall: monitoring for next 30m; if queue not below 200 and 503s persist, escalate to SEV1 and open bridge.
amy_ops: added context to incident ticket: impacted routes: /v1/generate-gpu, /v1/embeddings-gpu. Approx 12% of live traffic routed via ap-southeast4 before mitigation.
jai_infra: long-term follow-ups we should add to postmortem: - implement regional soft-cap alarms before autoscaler kicks - block autoscaler from scaling when quotaRejected metric spikes - add automated cross-region fallback for queued requests - consider pre-warming reserved GPUs in ap-southeast4 for peak windows.
maria_prod: observed latencies back to normal on snapshot; pending-alloc down from 2200 -> 180 in 12 minutes.
ben_custsuccess: AcmeCorp requests a writeup and RCA. I'll draft a customer-facing note once we have postmortem.
ryan_oncall: thanks team. I'll hand off to Lina for post-incident actions. leaving oncall. :white_check_mark:
lina_sre: picking up post-incident. creating a postmortem ticket and assigning follow-ups to infra and product. closing pager for now.
incident-bot: Pager closed by ryan_oncall at 4320003599.
